fy_label_note: December fiscal year; Baba/VA FY labels equal calendar years. FY2021 to FY2024 are JBT standalone (VA history appears restated to continuing FoodTech operations after the 2023 AeroTech sale: FY2019 revenue $1,945.7M drops to $1,234.5M in FY2020, so FY2019 and earlier are not comparable). FY2025 onward is the combined JBT Marel (closed 2025-01-02): revenue $1,716.0M FY2024 to $3,798.2M FY2025, EBITDA margin 17.19% to 15.81%, a mix break from adding Marel (Marel 2024 adjusted EBITDA margin 13%-14% per Sigurdsson, doc 48579), not a cyclical decline. Window = last five fiscal actuals FY2021 to FY2025; VA EBITDA is the target's adjusted EBITDA basis (stage 3: FY2025 VA 15.81%).

deciding_facts: Attribution ratio 0.17: JBT's EBITDA margin fell 373 bps FY2021 to FY2022 (18.05% to 14.32%) while the food-equipment peer median fell only 62 bps (16.79% to 16.17%) and GEA and Krones expanded; relative position swung from +125 bps to -186 bps.

Margin fell on revenue up 13.5%, and management tied it to fixed-price backlogs and shop-floor productivity plus missed FY2021 and FY2022 margin guides; the current 20% 2028 target mainly reverses Marel mix dilution (FY2024 17.19% to FY2025 15.81%), not a cycle.
confidence_note: Four peers, one-year trough window, and two VA history breaks (AeroTech restatement, Marel combination). The peer comparison isolates the 2022 inflation and supply-chain shock well.
